limitations: This milestone does not complete all PRD requirements or open production.

All persistent activity connectors remain disabled pending permission, implementation and verification; Garmin approval is pending and the approved COROS clarification was accepted but its delivery/reply is unverified.

Full authenticated desktop/mobile acceptance, broader FIT/TCX/ZIP and large/concurrent workload measurements remain open.
External alert receipt, full operational metrics/traces, PostHog reauthentication, live payment/payout readiness, business/retention policies and Vercel commercial eligibility remain unresolved.
Resend allocations and plan are unchanged; temporary deletion notices retain bounded recipients until acceptance or expiry.
The production Convex deployment is not in the EU region used for staging and R2.
